name: Anushka Jain
title: Ph.D. Candidate in Biology (Proteomics)
bio: I am a Ph.D. candidate in the Department of Biology at the University of Rochester, specializing in proteomics research. My work focuses on investigating protein folding dynamics through end-to-end research initiatives that integrate experimental workflows with large-scale quantitative analysis. I am passionate about leveraging data-driven approaches to advance our understanding of biological systems.
